name: TAS
recent: TAS 于 2026 年 10 月 28 日召开第 19 届常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。同期，已故大股东 Estate of Datuk Lau Nai Hoh 的股份通过直接商业交易转让给 Lau Choo Chin、Lau Choo Kuang 及 Lau Siew Ling，三人分别接受 24,856,250 股、24,856,250 股及 1,537,500 股。公司也于 11 月 11 日公告回购股份。
notable: 第 19 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 28 日举行，所有议案获股东通过。
已故大股东 Estate of Datuk Lau Nai Hoh 的股份于 2026 年 10 月 21 日通过直接商业交易转让给 Lau Choo Chin、Lau Choo Kuang 及 Lau Siew Ling。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 11 日公告回购股份。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭锁期內进行股份交易，涉及已故大股东遗产的股份转让。
相关议案已列入常年股东大会。

recent_en: TAS held its 19th Annual General Meeting on 28 October 2026, where all resolutions were passed. In the same period, shares of the deceased substantial shareholder Estate of Datuk Lau Nai Hoh were transferred via direct business transactions to Lau Choo Chin, Lau Choo Kuang and Lau Siew Ling, who accepted 24,856,250, 24,856,250 and 1,537,500 shares respectively. The company also announced a shares buyback on 11 November.
notable_en: The 19th Annual General Meeting was held on 28 October 2026, and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Shares of the deceased substantial shareholder Estate of Datuk Lau Nai Hoh were transferred on 21 October 2026 via direct business transactions to Lau Choo Chin, Lau Choo Kuang and Lau Siew Ling.
The company announced a shares buyback on 11 November 2026.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share dealings during the closed period, involving the transfer of shares from the deceased substantial shareholder's estate.
The company proposed to renew its share buyback authority, with the resolution tabled at the AGM.
